name: smwmusic-crash-nitro-kart-barin-ruins
title: Crash Nitro Kart - Barin Ruins
description:
A fast paced indian sounding track that plays in Barin Ruins, a track set in ancient ruins covered in ice, lava and machines.

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want to use:
0 - Default in-game version
1 - In-game version but with the addition of the drum intro from CTR Nitro-Fueled (0x0DFF)
